classification: Recalculation of saved outcomes, not a new replay, optimization, production recommendation, or evidence that model quotes are raw market data

definitions.cycle_start_equity: Account equity at start_signal_date close, known before first seller execution; all percent_start_equity metrics use this denominator.
definitions.recovery_days: Sessions whose saved end-of-day route is recovery_future. Exit is at next-session open; not all-day liquidation of the underlying.
definitions.insurance_days: Positive recovery_put end-of-day quantity, counted within each cycle before exit execution date.
definitions.premium: Gross paid premium is cash use; net insurance PnL equals the sum of equity_change and closed-position cash flows including fees. It is not gross premium plus MTM counted twice.
definitions.cycle_attributed_maxdd: MaxDD of 1 + cumulative attributed cycle equity_change / fixed cycle-start account equity, excluding momentum/grid/cash interest. This is distinct from account MaxDD.
definitions.recovery_window_account_metrics: Account close-to-close returns on recovery-route EOD rows; exclude exit-day ordinary afternoon exposure.
definitions.A0_terminal: A0 lacks endogenous cycle records; its route segment is not cost-complete cycle evidence. Missing terminal route is not an exit.
definitions.reported_annualization: Recomputed all N daily returns and 252/N annualization as metrics.json. The legacy native audit cagr uses N-1 and is not substituted for reported metrics.

interpretation_challenges.detail: All model-panel results are reconstructed-market sensitivity outcomes. A dated-open price_basis label inside its events does not convert model option/futures quotes into observed historical executions.

Model IC A0 has 744 recovery_future EOD rows from 2019-06-28 to 2022-07-20; terminal 2022-07-21 route is missing and no trade proves exit. A already changes the first recovery to 2 EOD sessions with 2019-07-02 exit, and a later 1-session cycle. This is the endogenous account-PnL/controller change; do not attribute A0 versus B/C to insurance.

interpretation_challenges.point: IM protection has a recovery-duration price
interpretation_challenges.detail: Model IM A/B/C starts recovery 2019-05-21 and exits 2019-12-20 / 2020-02-18 / 2020-03-16 after 146 / 181 / 200 EOD sessions. B/C consume about 4.11% / 4.10% of original cycle-start account equity in net insurance PnL; C helps the large crash but takes longer to regain cycle breakeven.

interpretation_challenges.point: Ordinary-scale B misses the crash insurance window
interpretation_challenges.detail: Model IM B holds zero recovery Put at 2020-01-23 close and 2020-02-03 close. Its 2020-02-03 account loss is worse than A; C holds insurance across the gap and materially reduces that day loss. B higher full-sample CAGR is not evidence of better crash protection.

interpretation_challenges.point: Global MaxDD can predate the tested protection
interpretation_challenges.detail: Model IM global MaxDD occurs 2015-09-29 before the 2019 recovery, identical across A/B/C. Listed IC global MaxDD and worst day also predate its 2025 recovery. Do not use unchanged global MaxDD alone as proof the recovery insurance never mitigates tail loss.

interpretation_challenges.point: State duration is not liquidation of the future
interpretation_challenges.detail: Recovery EOD-session counts end at the preceding close; protection closes at exit-day open. Core futures can continue as ordinary positions. Count insurance positive EOD holdings separately; do not call a state exit a closing sale of the underlying future.

interpretation_challenges.point: Listed C is two opening/closing pairs
interpretation_challenges.detail: Saved outputs contain IC BUY+SELL and IM BUY+SELL: four recovery_put trade rows, two completed insurance positions, three positive-insurance EOD sessions in total (IC2, IM1). All four independently match exact-contract positive raw open; no proxy used for these fills.

interpretation_challenges.point: Listed evidence cannot establish long-recovery benefit
interpretation_challenges.detail: Each listed product has one short recovery; A and B are financially identical, C adds cost and does not shorten recovery. Long recovery and crash-mitigation inferences rest on model IM, not the raw-listed observations.

interpretation_challenges.point: Existing opening mark fallback is present outside new insurance
interpretation_challenges.detail: Listed IC has 2 prior-close open fallback calls per arm and listed IM 17; these include opening marks, not just fills. Report alongside 4 raw-open new insurance trades. Model zero fallback is not raw-data certification.

instrumented_rerun_verification.scope: Only new read-only native quote fallback observations; no evidence of a new strategy branch or changed pricing decisions.

native_open_fallback_audit.definition: Invocation count of existing Market.quote open-with-prior_day path when exact positive open is absent; includes opening MTM and other calls, not necessarily executions or unique contracts.
native_open_fallback_audit.summary: Listed IC: 2 calls per arm; listed IM: 17 calls per arm; model IC/IM: 0 calls per arm. Do not sum repeated A0/A/B/C observations into a count of distinct historical fills.
native_open_fallback_audit.insurance_specific: The newly added listed C recovery insurance has 4 trade rows (2 opening/closing pairs), all exact raw open, no sticky-IV or prior-close substitution. Existing other-sleeve fallback calls remain explicitly disclosed.
native_open_fallback_audit.model_boundary: Zero prior-close fallback in model does not prove raw market opens; model has constructed open fields. Labels such as dated_open remain subject to panel classification.
